title: new crashes with a shlex traceback on a --repro or --check command with an unclosed quote instead of a usage error
goal: backlog.py new with a --repro or --check value whose command has an unclosed quote (such as an apostrophe in a word) exits 2 with a usage error naming the option, and writes no item, instead of a ValueError traceback from shlex.split in bl_items.parse_cmd; set already does this. Found while fixing BG-4iaxny3s.

run: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,"new","bug","--title","t","--severity","S3","--goal","g","--repro","echo it"+chr(39)+"s"],capture_output=True,text=True); sys.exit(1 if "Traceback" in p.stderr or p.returncode != 2 else 0)
